technical-summary: rad0034 --max-prefill-seqs N (opt-in, default 0): cap concurrent long prefills; prompts whose remainder fits one shared step bypass at any share. Hardware on -long-bf16: eight 100k prompts mean TTFT 434 -> 208 s (cap 1), no preemptions, short requests 3.6-4.5 s (was 321-338 s).
user-summary-candidate: Optional limit on how many very long prompts are processed at once: with eight 100,000-token prompts arriving together, they start answering in half the time on average, and short questions sent alongside get an answer in seconds instead of minutes.
